children: Gold prices went up on Sunday, October 11, with the international ounce recording $4,195.2 for buying and $4.194.1 for selling.
The 24-karat gold was priced at EGP 7,089.95 for purchase and EGP 6,998.25 for sale, according to Dahab Masr at 3:44 PM.
Meanwhile, the 21-karat gold increased to EGP 6,204.33 for buying and EGP 6,124.08 for selling.
Likewise, the 18-karat gold rose to EGP 5,318 for purchase and EGP 5,249.21 for sale.
The gold coin amounted to EGP 49,634.64 for buying and EGP 48,992.64 for selling.

title: ZAWYA: Gold prices in Egypt record collective gains on October 11
